title: A company paying for its staff
notice: A sample payer that is not an insurer: a company pays 70% of what its staff buy, up to 2,000 a sale. No price list and no formulary: it covers every item. It shows that a second payer of another kind is data, never code.
sources: BRD §7 item 6 and blueprint §7: a third-party payer is a cross-vertical primitive (optical plans, corporate accounts)
